title: pinus luchuensis var. hwangshanensis
intro: Pinus luchuensis var. hwangshanensis, commonly known as the Chinese fir, is a plant species within the Pinaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, including its antitumor, antibacterial, and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Pinus luchuensis var. hwangshanensis are attributed to its ability to promote wound healing, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include terpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
